title: Trading with grokbot
author: thenewmemeking
selftext:
Ive been researching ai trading and memecoins for a bit now and as of recently ive found a lot of people were making money trough grokbot and want to give it a chance.

If i wanna make my groupchat of bots do i have to pay for a subscription and do i get a free trial?

Can i also use a demo version 1st so i dont throw my money away?

Thank you all!!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: no idea what grokbot charges, but before paying anything look at who is posting the "people making money" screenshots. with memecoin bots it's very often the bot's own affiliates. if there's no demo, run it with an amount you'd be fine losing entirely for a few weeks and count the fees.
